creation.prompt: Create exactly one reusable needle-felt Milo character asset on a truly transparent background. Reference 1 is the approved identity: preserve rounded forehead and cheeks, cream muzzle and chest inset, moss-green irises, large rounded grey-interior ears, charcoal nose, muted burnt-orange felt tail, warm neutral-grey matted wool and handmade texture. Mouth closed, no visible teeth, no mane, no hair tuft, no pot belly. Use neutral even studio illumination so forest sunset lighting is not baked into intrinsic colours. Leave comfortable padding around every requested body part. No forest, props, ground plate, typography, labels, watermark, collage or multiple figures. This is a candidate performance asset, not a replacement canonical. Create an angle-specific neutral portrait base, three-quarter facing screen-right: the complete head with BOTH ears and ample clearance, neck and upper chest. Preserve the canonical head/ear/muzzle silhouette and eye geometry; calm attentive eyes and a soft neutral closed-mouth expression. No face-only mask or detached face sticker. No camera or anatomy exaggeration. This neutral base will be reviewed before making startled and determined expression variants.
